name: juslintek/swiftcov
description: swiftcov: a fast, Xdebug-API-compatible PHP code coverage engine (line, branch, path) with a block-based backend. Registers at runtime as 'xdebug' so php-code-coverage/PHPUnit consume it unchanged, while making branch/path coverage nearly as cheap as line coverage.

configure-options.name: enable-swiftcov
configure-options.description: whether to enable the swiftcov coverage engine
